item.title: Warm Music for Morning Tips

turns.text: Add some warm, hopeful music to this clip, nothing too energetic. Keep the whole video and my voice.

item.tests: Tests whether the delivered video adds music matching an explicit mood while preserving the source footage and speech.

answer_sheet.Music mood: Warm and hopeful, with gentle energy rather than a driving beat.
answer_sheet.Footage and length: Use the entire attached 10-second clip without changing its visuals or timing.
answer_sheet.Original audio: Keep my original voice audible and understandable.
answer_sheet.Platform, framing, and added text: Keep the original framing. No added text; no particular platform.

must_haves: The output contains the full original 10-second kitchen-table video, with no new shots or altered playback speed.
Added music is clearly audible and has a warm, hopeful, gentle character rather than an aggressive or high-energy feel.
The woman's original spoken introduction remains audible and understandable throughout.
The added music ends with the video rather than continuing over extra footage or a blank screen.

turns.text: Could you add some music to the clip I've attached? I've been going back and forth about asking for help with this because I tend to overthink these little things. Please keep the whole video and my voice. For the music, I mean something warm and hopeful, but nothing too energetic. I'm excited to see how it feels with music underneath it.

dialog.agent:
Warm, hopeful music with a gentle pace sounds like a good fit—soft piano and subtle ambient textures, without vocals competing with your voice.

I can generate a soundtrack here, but the connected tools can’t mix it into your attached clip while preserving the full video and original voice. I haven’t changed your file.

If you’d like a separate music track to layer underneath, **how long is the clip?** In an editor, you’d keep the video intact and lower the music further whenever you’re speaking.
dialog.user: The clip is 10 seconds long, so a separate music track for that length would be great. I want to use the entire clip without changing its visuals or timing, and keep my voice audible and understandable. The instrumentation is your call, as long as it feels warm and hopeful rather than too energetic.

dialog.agent:
The music generator has a **15-second minimum**, so I can’t make an exact 10-second track here.

Would a **15-second instrumental** with gentle piano and warm ambient textures work? You could use its first 10 seconds beneath your full clip, keeping the visuals, timing, and voice unchanged.
dialog.user: Yes, please go ahead with the 15-second instrumental; I can use the first 10 seconds underneath the full clip. Gentle piano and warm ambient textures sound good, as long as the music stays warm and hopeful without being too energetic. I also want to keep the original framing and won’t be adding any text.

turns.agent:
The music generation was blocked because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. **No track was created**, and your original clip is unchanged.

The approved 15-second track requires **15 credits**. Once those are available, I can try again with the same gentle piano and warm ambient textures.

Calm optimism, never energetic or dramatic. No percussion-heavy rhythm, no big swells; leave plenty of sonic space for an audible, understandable speaking voice. Begin gently right away so the first 10 seconds work as a standalone background bed.
